objective: Start the weekly numerics clinic with a hypothesis written from analysis before any run, and correct its own agenda first, because two of the three anomalies the strategy names have moved: one was retracted by the lab's own record and the other had its ownership question answered
rationale: The clinic's value is the discipline of a hypothesis before a run, and its first act should be to fix its own list, because a clinic working from a stale agenda is a clinic that proves the wrong thing. Of the three named anomalies, the first is retracted. The backward-facing step's reattachment was recorded as landing a factor of 4 to 12 short of the reference value of 6.26 step heights with a second unexplained separation further downstream; the cause is named and was proven at a commit nine days before the record was amended, namely that the wall-shear detector read the sign backwards, so the crossing being called reattachment was the downstream edge of the corner eddy and the second separation was the real reattachment. Corrected, the case sits at about minus 10.5 percent, inside the documented linear-eddy-viscosity family. What genuinely remains open there is narrower and worth stating: the primary reattachment's own wander has never been measured cleanly, because the wander that was measured belonged to the corner eddy. The second anomaly's ownership question closed the same night the strategy was adopted, by a controlled twin at matched cell counts, and what remains open is the mechanism, because the generator-parameter ablation that would confirm the unscaled-smoothing hypothesis has never been run and the generator is not installed on the host that measured the matrix. The third is genuinely open and is the strongest first clinic case: a transonic wing-body primal whose drag is stable to six significant figures and matches its published reference to 0.0067 percent, sitting beside a printed temperature-residual statistic of order 8.5e8 at the same checkpoint. The recorded suspicion is that this is the same category of signal as an earlier field collapse that hid behind a reassuring headline, but the pattern that identified that one has not been found here and the contradiction has not been demonstrated, so the honest state is that the drag number is provisional until the temperature residual's per-iteration trace is read. That trace is a log read, not a run, which makes it exactly the theory-first shape the clinic is for. Axis A: report-kind at zero solver cost. Axis B: 0, though outcome one would move a provisional wall-facing number to settled or to withdrawn. Axis C: 0.

cost_basis: measured; all three anomalies have their runs and logs on disk already, the first clinic session's deliverable is a trace read plus a written hypothesis, and any arm a session proposes is filed and priced separately rather than folded into the session, so the clinic itself opens no case and spends no solver time
expected_knowledge_gain: The first session alone has three separable outcomes on the temperature-residual case, and they are opposite decisions. The trace decays, in which case the raw statistic is a normalisation artefact, the drag number stops being provisional and a wall-facing result settles. The trace plateaus honestly, in which case the residual is real, the convergence claim is weaker than stated and the record gets a caveat. The trace collapses to a fixed value, in which case it is the earlier field-collapse pattern, the drag number is withdrawn, and a second case joins that family. Beyond the first session, the clinic's standing product is the corrected agenda itself: two of the three named anomalies are not what the strategy says they are, and a written correction stops the lab from re-solving a retracted number.
sequencing: Dispatchable now. Strategy rule 4 ride-along, theory-first, no new compute; any run a session motivates is filed as its own proposal with its own price.
gate: STRATEGY PROOF CLAUSE, verbatim: 'Weekly "numerics clinic": one open anomaly (F5c 4-12x reattachment, NACA0012 aspect ratio, temperature-residual signature) gets a theory-first treatment -- hypothesis from analysis before any run.' Operationalised: session zero re-states the anomaly list against the record and files corrections for the entries the record has already moved, naming the retraction and the closed ownership question so no session re-solves a withdrawn number. Each session thereafter takes exactly one open anomaly, writes a hypothesis and the observation that would refute it before touching any run, and closes with one of three dispositions, resolved with the mechanism named, refuted with the hypothesis recorded as dead, or converted into a priced proposal for the one measurement that would decide it. A session that runs anything before its hypothesis is committed fails the clause regardless of what it finds.
